title: 手持电动工具与砂轮机
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/127_手持电动工具与砂轮机.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/127_手持电动工具与砂轮机/src.py

points.K3: 用前检查，坏工具停用不凑合
points.K4: 防触电：双重绝缘、漏电保护、线缆完好
points.K5: 开关松手即停，不得锁定
points.K7: 砂轮片：额定转速够，装前查裂纹
points.S1: 台式砂轮机：站侧面启动，托架调好，不用侧面磨
points.K9: 夹牢工件，双手握稳，停转再放
points.K10: 个人防护：护目镜加面屏，护听、防尘
points.K11: 振动和噪声：分段作业，轮换休息

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在工具墙前，工具都已拔掉电源
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a tidy wall of unplugged hand power tools and a bench grinder, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：手持电动工具与砂轮机。
overlay: 手持电动工具与砂轮机

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一片砂轮片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a grinding disc and points at its blank label area.
shots.narration: 小工具，也能出大事故。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一台角磨机，护罩不见了，电线缠着胶布
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up an angle grinder that has no guard and a power cord wrapped with tape.
shots.narration: 阿杰要切铁片，拿了台没护罩的角磨机。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他还从别的机器上拆来一片砂轮片
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a disc taken from a different machine being fitted to the angle grinder, a question mark above. No text.
shots.narration: 砂轮片也是随手从别处拿的。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老李拦住他，按住插头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops him, holding the unplugged plug away from the socket.
shots.narration: 老李：先别插电，这台工具不能用！

shots.section_title: 电动工具的七种危害
shots.scene: 电钻、角磨机、切割机、电焊机图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, an electric drill, an angle grinder, a cut off saw and a welding machine, each with a lightning bolt. No text.
shots.narration: 靠电驱动的工具，就是电动工具。

shots.section_title: 电动工具的七种危害
shots.scene: 触电和起火爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two warning icons, an electric shock and a fire with an explosion. No text.
shots.narration: 危害一触电，二火灾和爆炸。

shots.section_title: 电动工具的七种危害
shots.scene: 火花飞溅和割伤图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two warning icons, sparks flying from a disc and a cut on a hand from a blade. No text.
shots.narration: 三是飞溅的火花，四是割伤。

shots.section_title: 电动工具的七种危害
shots.scene: 火花溅到身上烧伤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sparks landing on a sleeve and causing a burn, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 五是火花和热工件烧伤。

shots.section_title: 电动工具的七种危害
shots.scene: 噪声和振动图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two warning icons, an ear with sound waves and a hand with vibration lines. No text.
shots.narration: 六是噪声伤听力，七是振动伤手臂。

shots.section_title: 电动工具的七种危害
shots.scene: 砂轮碎片飞出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fragments of a broken grinding disc flying outward from a tool, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 砂轮一碎，碎片像子弹一样飞。

shots.section_title: 先培训授权，再上手
shots.scene: 王老师给学生做工具培训
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains a small group of students on how to use a hand power tool that is unplugged.
shots.narration: 工作间的工具，先培训再使用。

shots.section_title: 先培训授权，再上手
shots.scene: 考核合格，登记授权
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a test sheet with a tick, a blank authorization card and a tool sign out logbook. No text.
shots.narration: 考核合格、登记授权，才能上手。

shots.section_title: 先培训授权，再上手
shots.scene: 电焊需要特种作业证
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding machine with a blank special operation certificate card beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 电焊等特种作业，按规定持证。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，坏工具停用不凑合
shots.scene: 【实拍】拔掉电源的角磨机：看外壳有无裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands turning an unplugged angle grinder to inspect its housing for cracks.
shots.narration: 用前检查：先看外壳有无破裂。
overlay: 用前检查，坏工具停用不凑合

shots.section_title: 用前检查，坏工具停用不凑合
shots.scene: 【实拍】顺着电线摸查外皮和插头（未插电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands running along an unplugged tool cord, then checking the plug pins and plug body.
shots.narration: 电线有没有破皮，插头松没松、焦没焦。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，坏工具停用不凑合
shots.scene: 开关、护罩、刀具逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist with a switch, a guard and a cutting disc, each with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 开关、护罩、刀具也看一看。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，坏工具停用不凑合
shots.scene: 胶布缠线、焊补的工具打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tool cord wrapped with tape and a broken tool handle welded with a pipe, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 坏了不缠胶布、不焊补凑合。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，坏工具停用不凑合
shots.scene: 坏工具挂停用牌，报修或报废
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged tool with a blank out of service tag going into a repair box. No text.
shots.narration: 挂牌停用，报修或报废。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，坏工具停用不凑合
shots.scene: 按周期检查维护，贴检查标签
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer testing a tool on a bench, then sticking a blank inspection label with a calendar icon. No text.
shots.narration: 工具按规定定期检查维护。

shots.section_title: 防触电：双重绝缘、漏电保护、线缆完好
shots.scene: 双重绝缘标志的工具
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand power tool with a double square insulation symbol and a shield over the hand. No text.
shots.narration: 选双重绝缘的工具，漏电不上手。
overlay: 防触电：双重绝缘、漏电保护、线缆完好

shots.section_title: 防触电：双重绝缘、漏电保护、线缆完好
shots.scene: 金属外壳工具要接地
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal bodied tool with a ground connection icon in the plug. No text.
shots.narration: 金属外壳的工具，要可靠接地。

shots.section_title: 防触电：双重绝缘、漏电保护、线缆完好
shots.scene: 插座回路配漏电保护器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a socket circuit protected by a residual current device with a test button. No text.
shots.narration: 电源配漏电保护，按规定电压供电。

shots.section_title: 防触电：双重绝缘、漏电保护、线缆完好
shots.scene: 潮湿处、金属容器内选合适的工具
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wet floor and the inside of a metal tank with a low voltage tool icon and a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 潮湿、狭窄的金属环境，按规定选工具。

shots.section_title: 防触电：双重绝缘、漏电保护、线缆完好
shots.scene: 电缆破皮立即停用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged tool cable with exposed wires and a stop hand icon. No text.
shots.narration: 电缆破皮，立即停用。

shots.section_title: 开关松手即停，不得锁定
shots.scene: 松开开关，工具立刻停
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand releasing the trigger of a drill and the rotation arrow stopping. No text.
shots.narration: 开关要松手即停。
overlay: 开关松手即停，不得锁定

shots.section_title: 开关松手即停，不得锁定
shots.scene: 用前空试开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand testing the switch of an unplugged tool, pressing and releasing it, with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 用前试一试，开关灵不灵。

shots.section_title: 开关松手即停，不得锁定
shots.scene: 开关被胶带缠死在常开位置，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tool trigger taped down in the on position, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 开关不能卡死、锁定在常开。

shots.section_title: 开关松手即停，不得锁定
shots.scene: 工具脱手乱转伤人，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dropped grinder still spinning on the floor and moving toward a leg, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 锁定了开关，失手时工具会乱转。

shots.section_title: 防护罩装好，不能拆
shots.scene: 角磨机护罩罩住砂轮朝向人的一侧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an angle grinder with its guard covering the half of the disc that faces the operator. No text.
shots.narration: 防护罩要装好，挡在人和砂轮之间。

shots.section_title: 防护罩装好，不能拆
shots.scene: 拆掉护罩的角磨机打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an angle grinder without a guard, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 嫌碍事拆掉护罩，绝对不行。

shots.section_title: 防护罩装好，不能拆
shots.scene: 台式砂轮机护罩完好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bench grinder with both wheel guards and eye shields in place, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 砂轮机必须装好护罩。

shots.section_title: 砂轮片：额定转速够，装前查裂纹
shots.scene: 【实拍】核对砂轮片上的额定转速和工具铭牌（未插电，遮挡品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger pointing at the speed marking on a grinding disc, then at the nameplate of an unplugged angle grinder.
shots.narration: 换片前，核对片子和机器的标示。
overlay: 砂轮片：额定转速够，装前查裂纹

shots.section_title: 砂轮片：额定转速够，装前查裂纹
shots.scene: 砂轮额定转速不低于机器转速
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two dials side by side, the disc rated speed equal to or higher than the tool speed, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 片子的额定转速，不能低于机器转速。

shots.section_title: 砂轮片：额定转速够，装前查裂纹
shots.scene: 超速砂轮碎裂飞出，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a disc spinning faster than its rating and shattering, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 机器比片子快，砂轮会碎裂飞出。

shots.section_title: 砂轮片：额定转速够，装前查裂纹
shots.scene: 尺寸和类型要匹配，切割片和磨片不同
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thin cutting disc and a thicker grinding disc side by side with matching tool icons. No text.
shots.narration: 尺寸、类型要对，切割片只用来切。

shots.section_title: 砂轮片：额定转速够，装前查裂纹
shots.scene: 用切割片侧面打磨，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thin cutting disc being used flat on its side to grind a surface, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 切割片不能拿侧面去磨。

shots.section_title: 砂轮片：额定转速够，装前查裂纹
shots.scene: 【实拍】砂轮装前敲击检查：用木槌轻敲听声（未装机）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a grinding wheel hung on a finger through its centre hole and tapped lightly with a small wooden mallet.
shots.narration: 装前敲一敲，声音清脆才是好的。

shots.section_title: 砂轮片：额定转速够，装前查裂纹
shots.scene: 有裂纹、受潮、过期的砂轮报废
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cracked wheel, a damp wheel and a wheel with an expired date label, all going into a scrap bin. No text.
shots.narration: 声音发闷、有裂纹，立即报废。

shots.section_title: 台式砂轮机：站侧面启动，托架调好，不用侧面磨
shots.scene: 【实拍】台式砂轮机断电状态：检查护罩、观察挡板和工件托架
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand pointing at the wheel guard, the clear eye shield and the work rest of a switched off bench grinder.
shots.narration: 台式砂轮机：护罩、挡板、托架都要好。
overlay: 台式砂轮机：站侧面启动，托架调好，不用侧面磨

shots.section_title: 台式砂轮机：站侧面启动，托架调好，不用侧面磨
shots.scene: 托架贴近砂轮，按规程调好间隙
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a work rest set close to the wheel with a small gap, a large gap crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 托架贴近砂轮，间隙按规程调。

shots.section_title: 台式砂轮机：站侧面启动，托架调好，不用侧面磨
shots.scene: 启动时人站在侧面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person standing to the side of a bench grinder while switching it on, a danger zone in front of the wheel. No text.
shots.narration: 启动时站侧面，空转正常再用。

shots.section_title: 台式砂轮机：站侧面启动，托架调好，不用侧面磨
shots.scene: 用砂轮侧面磨削，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a workpiece pressed against the flat side of a bench grinder wheel, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用砂轮圆周面磨，不用侧面。

shots.section_title: 台式砂轮机：站侧面启动，托架调好，不用侧面磨
shots.scene: 两人同用一台、用力猛压，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two people grinding on the same wheel at once and a person pushing hard, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 一人一台，不猛压，不磨大件。

shots.section_title: 清走可燃物，挡住火花
shots.scene: 作业区周围堆着纸箱和溶剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cardboard boxes and a solvent bottle near a grinding area, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 打磨切割前，看周围有什么。

shots.section_title: 清走可燃物，挡住火花
shots.scene: 清走可燃易燃物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person moving boxes and a solvent bottle away from the work area, leaving a clear zone. No text.
shots.narration: 先清走可燃、易燃物品。

shots.section_title: 清走可燃物，挡住火花
shots.scene: 用防火挡板围住火花
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fire resistant screen placed around a grinding spot so sparks stay inside. No text.
shots.narration: 用防火挡板把火花围住。

shots.section_title: 清走可燃物，挡住火花
shots.scene: 火花朝向空地，不朝人和物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sparks directed toward an empty floor area, away from people and equipment. No text.
shots.narration: 火花朝向空地，不对人、不对物。

shots.section_title: 清走可燃物，挡住火花
shots.scene: 动火许可和灭火器就位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank hot work permit and a fire extinguisher standing ready near the work area. No text.
shots.narration: 实验楼里打磨切割，按动火管理。

shots.section_title: 夹牢工件，双手握稳，停转再放
shots.scene: 【实拍】工件夹在台虎钳上（未插电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands clamping a small metal workpiece firmly in a bench vice.
shots.narration: 工件用夹具夹牢，不用手扶。
overlay: 夹牢工件，双手握稳，停转再放

shots.section_title: 夹牢工件，双手握稳，停转再放
shots.scene: 【实拍】双手握住角磨机主把手和侧手柄（未插电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: two hands holding an unplugged angle grinder by the body and the side handle, feet set apart.
shots.narration: 双手握稳工具，站稳再开机。

shots.section_title: 夹牢工件，双手握稳，停转再放
shots.scene: 单手操作、站在梯子上探身，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person using a grinder with one hand while leaning from a ladder, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不单手操作，不探身够着干。

shots.section_title: 夹牢工件，双手握稳，停转再放
shots.scene: 工件放在合适高度，不弯腰硬撑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a workpiece on a bench at elbow height and a person standing upright, a bent over posture crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 工件放在合适高度，别弯腰硬撑。

shots.section_title: 夹牢工件，双手握稳，停转再放
shots.scene: 砂轮完全停转再放下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a grinder disc slowing to a stop before the tool is laid down on its back, a clock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 完全停转，再放下工具。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：护目镜加面屏，护听、防尘
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴护目镜、再戴面屏、戴耳罩（冷态示范）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a person putting on safety goggles, then lowering a face shield, then fitting ear muffs.
shots.narration: 眼睛双重防护：护目镜加面屏。
overlay: 个人防护：护目镜加面屏，护听、防尘

shots.section_title: 个人防护：护目镜加面屏，护听、防尘
shots.scene: 皮手套和阻燃围裙
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: leather gloves and a flame resistant apron with sparks bouncing off. No text.
shots.narration: 打磨切割，戴皮手套、穿围裙。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：护目镜加面屏，护听、防尘
shots.scene: 台式砂轮机按规程不戴手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bench grinder with a loose glove near the wheel crossed out, bare hands holding a small piece with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 台式砂轮机按规程，防手套被卷。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：护目镜加面屏，护听、防尘
shots.scene: 噪声大戴耳塞或耳罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: ear plugs and ear muffs next to a loud grinder with sound waves. No text.
shots.narration: 噪声大，戴耳塞或耳罩。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：护目镜加面屏，护听、防尘
shots.scene: 粉尘多戴防尘口罩，开局部排风
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person wearing a particle respirator while grinding, with a local exhaust hood drawing dust away. No text.
shots.narration: 粉尘多，戴防尘口罩，开排风。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：护目镜加面屏，护听、防尘
shots.scene: 束发扎袖，不穿化纤衣
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with tied hair, buttoned cuffs and cotton work clothes, a synthetic loose jacket crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 束发扎袖，穿纯棉或阻燃工作服。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：护目镜加面屏，护听、防尘
shots.scene: 旁人也要防护或离开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bystander behind a screen wearing safety glasses, another person walking away from the grinding area. No text.
shots.narration: 旁边的人，也要挡住或离开。

shots.section_title: 振动和噪声：分段作业，轮换休息
shots.scene: 手指发白发麻
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand with pale white fingertips and numbness lines after using a vibrating tool. No text.
shots.narration: 长期振动，手指会发白发麻。
overlay: 振动和噪声：分段作业，轮换休息

shots.section_title: 振动和噪声：分段作业，轮换休息
shots.scene: 选低振动工具，分段作业
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a low vibration tool icon and a timer split into short work blocks with rest breaks. No text.
shots.narration: 选低振工具，分段作业勤休息。

shots.section_title: 振动和噪声：分段作业，轮换休息
shots.scene: 两人轮换
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two workers taking turns at a grinding task, a rotation arrow between them. No text.
shots.narration: 长时间作业，轮换着干。

shots.section_title: 振动和噪声：分段作业，轮换休息
shots.scene: 手麻耳鸣及时报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with ringing ears and a numb hand reporting to the lab supervisor. No text.
